title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-01 18:41:46 UTC - the one stamp all five cards carry. Scope: the four public repos; the private one is out of scope.

The owner's desk has items older than one week: 37 of the 50 open issues predate this stamp by more than 7 d, the eight owner-action ones among them. Oldest, qlever-dir#2, opened 2026-07-08 18:46:04 UTC - 23 d 23 h.

52 issues, 50 open, 2 closed - retinue 34 open, qlever-dir 8, chamber 7, deployment 1. Eight PRs merged since the last stamp, one of them mine: retinue#55 at 2026-07-31 19:33:40 UTC, the first merged here from any account but his. One PR open org-wide, chamber#9, mine. He asked me a question on retinue#60 at 18:28:06 UTC, unanswered at this stamp. My token still cannot push here: 81 commits unpushed, so this page is committed, not served. 0 stars, forks and watchers on all four since 2026-07-18.
